description: highly detailed HD pixel art with painterly shading and layered depth, a cinematic wide establishing shot for a trucking tycoon game: Albany with the Empire State Plaza and the Egg, its real skyline rising in the middle distance with every landmark clearly recognisable, seen from above a busy interstate in the foreground where American long-nose conventional semi tractors with long hoods, chrome grilles and sleeper cabs pull white trailers, never a flat-faced European cab-over truck, a blank green overhead highway sign, the city's own surroundings and water or hills beyond, a bright clear winter day after a snowfall, snow on every roof, verge and shoulder, the freeway ploughed and dark, bare trees, a pale blue-white sky with a low winter sun, long cool shadows, no text, lettering, words, labels or logos anywhere
